emily: Heads-up: deploying a new dedicated GPU class 'G6-Max-Q' to ams-1a and ams-1b tonight at 03:00 UTC. Target: high-throughput batch inferencing. Rotation reservations enabled.

raj: Additive or replacement?

emily: Additive. No forced migrations; old preemptible A100 burst capacity may be reallocated over time.

emily: Quick summary:
- Regions: ams-1a, ams-1b (initial).
- Capacity: ~48 cards to start, scaling weekly.
- Reservation model: rotation (time-sliced guarantees).
- Priority: enterprise reserved > dedicated reserved > rotation > burst.

emily: CLI example:
`redwood reserve create --pool g6-max-q --region ams --duration 30d --rotation --cards 4 --name ml-batch-q1`

capacity-bot: Inventory: ams-1a: 26 available, ams-1b: 22. Nightly replenish +8 cards at 03:00 UTC.

tamika: Billing for rotation?

emily: Finance: please confirm.

finance-bot: Rotation reservations billed at 60% of a full dedicated card rate (prorated). Applies to new rotation reservations from tonight.

michael: Console: add tooltip for rotation windows and billing. Deploying tomorrow.

sara: Don't use rotation for low-latency prod endpoints. Recommend dedicated/pinned pools.

oncall-sre: Maintenance window in ams-1b 02:40-03:10 UTC tonight; rotation reservations paused then. Avoid critical runs.

raj: Who to ping for migration help A100 -> G6-Max-Q?

emily: Ping #eng-ml with traces and perf targets. We'll assist with mapping and profiling.

emily: TL;DR: G6-Max-Q live in AMS tonight, rotation reservations enabled, billing proration 60%, short maintenance window. Test on non-critical batches first. :thumbsup:
